rules.title: Every allocation has its defer
rules.what: Pair every alloc/create with a defer free/destroy (or use an arena with a clear lifetime), make allocator ownership explicit, and test the allocation-failure path.
rules.why: An alloc without defer leaks on every early return, and early returns are the normal control flow of error unions.
rules.how: const buf = try allocator.alloc(u8, n); defer allocator.free(buf); std.testing.FailingAllocator in tests.

patterns.note: Allocation in a file with no defer free/destroy or arena.

verify.how: Tests run with the testing allocator (leak detection) and a failing allocator.

rules.title: Bounded reads and fixed buffers
rules.what: Bound every read of external input with a maximum sized to the format, and use slices and fixed buffers where bounds are known.
rules.why: readAllAlloc with a large maximum lets the other end decide how much memory you allocate: a denial of service written as a convenience.
rules.how: reader.readAllAlloc(allocator, max_size) with a format-derived max; or read into a fixed buffer in a loop.

patterns.note: Whole-input read; check the maximum is sized to the format.

verify.how: Oversized input test is rejected cleanly within the bound.
